facts.fact: Loi n° 47-2024 of 30 December 2024 sets a ceiling of XAF 2,810,000,000 for 2025 on special Treasury account n° 14, the fund for operationalising the Treasury's banking function, which finances the action plan for the Treasury's digital platform run by or for the state systems agency ACSI.
facts.system: Fonds pour l'opérationnalisation de la fonction bancaire du Trésor public, 2025 budget

note: The account was created by Loi n° 39-2023; no collection or payment is shown, so no acted fact; the document gives no prior-year comparison.
